requirements.statement: MUL and MLA produce the low 32 bits of a 32-by-32 product with optional modulo-2^32 accumulation; UMULL/UMLAL and SMULL/SMLAL produce unsigned or signed 64-bit products with optional modulo-2^64 accumulation.
Flag-setting common multiplies update N and Z from the 32-bit or 64-bit result. ARMv5 and later leave C and V unchanged; ARMv4 leaves short-multiply C and long-multiply C/V UNPREDICTABLE.

requirements.notes: The ARM9TDMI datapath deterministically preserves incoming C/V while separately asserting unconstrained-output indicators. No public implementation-specific source has yet established the silicon values within the architecture's UNPREDICTABLE space.
